reason: Judge failed to link Aboriginal circumstances to sentence, an error of law; court reduced sentence to 9 months and modified s. 161 order.
Judge considered Gladue factors; banishment not weighed was error but 2 years still fit at low end, appeal dismissed.
Judge gave inadequate weight to s. 718.2(e) and background; court substituted a three month conditional sentence.
Conditional sentence found unfit but left in place; Gladue factors supported short length and programs underway, so appeal dismissed.
Court took judicial notice of Aboriginal systemic factors and disabilities, replaced conditional sentence with conditional discharge.
